description: Recompute and save the 40-ortholog AlphaFold confidence survey with its distribution figure
code:
import requests, numpy as np, pandas as pd, matplotlib.pyplot as plt
P="/agent/jobs/d6553e06-db35-4151-9e50-1fa1a83dba56/provenance/"
r=requests.get("https://rest.uniprot.org/uniprotkb/search",
  params={'query':'(xref:pfam-PF28230) AND (database:alphafolddb)','format':'json','size':500,
          'fields':'accession,organism_name,length'}, timeout=240)
res=r.json()['results']
by_genus={}
for e in res: by_genus.setdefault(e['organism']['scientificName'].split()[0], e)
rows=[]
for e in list(by_genus.values())[:40]:
    acc=e['primaryAccession']
    try:
        p=requests.get(f"https://alphafold.ebi.ac.uk/files/AF-{acc}-F1-model_v6.pdb",timeout=45).text
        bf=np.array([float(l[60:66]) for l in p.splitlines() if l.startswith("ATOM") and l[12:16].strip()=="CA"])
        if not len(bf): continue
        runs=[len(s) for s in "".join('1' if v>70 else '0' for v in bf).split('0')]
        rows.append(dict(acc=acc, organism=e['organism']['scientificName'], length=len(bf),
                         mean_pLDDT=round(float(bf.mean()),1), frac_gt70=round(float((bf>70).mean()),3),
                         longest_ordered_run=int(max(runs))))
    except Exception: pass
fam=pd.DataFrame(rows).sort_values('mean_pLDDT',ascending=False)
fam.to_csv(P+"PRM5_family_ortholog_pLDDT_survey.csv",index=False)
print(f"n={len(fam)} orthologs, one per genus. mean of means {fam.mean_pLDDT.mean():.1f}, "
      f"range {fam.mean_pLDDT.min()}-{fam.mean_pLDDT.max()}, n above 70 = {(fam.mean_pLDDT>70).sum()}")

fig,b=plt.subplots(figsize=(7.2,4.3))
b.hist(fam.mean_pLDDT,bins=np.arange(46,76,2),color='#6b7a8f',edgecolor='white')
ymax=b.get_ylim()[1]
b.axvline(70,color='#b03a2e',ls='--',lw=1.8); b.text(70.5,ymax*.78,'pLDDT 70\nthreshold for\nfold assignment',fontsize=8.5,color='#b03a2e')
b.axvline(57.2,color='#2b4c7e',lw=2.0); b.text(57.6,ymax*.45,'PRM5\n57.2',fontsize=9,color='#2b4c7e')
b.set_xlabel('mean pLDDT of the AlphaFold model'); b.set_ylabel('number of orthologs')
b.set_title(f'AlphaFold confidence across {len(fam)} PF28230 orthologs, one per fungal genus\n'
            f'0 of {len(fam)} reach mean pLDDT 70; range {fam.mean_pLDDT.min()} to {fam.mean_pLDDT.max()}, mean {fam.mean_pLDDT.mean():.1f}',
            fontsize=10,loc='left')
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
print(fam.head(10).to_string(index=False))
